Its description: ## Summary - **Per-item pre-build breaker.** The drain added to `failure_count` only on a task-level failure. A system-level failure before build (for example `TRIAGE_COMMITMENT_INVALID`) never reached the quarantine ceiling, so every wave claimed the item again. Now the drain records each failing cycle in `prebuild_failure_cycles` on the charged item. At the policy value `prebuild_failure_ceiling` (default 2), it parks the item in the existing `quarantine/` and emits the inbox.warning `INBOX_ITEM_PREBUILD_BREAKER`, which names the item, the cycles and the ceiling.
